FINAL HANDOFF:
[handoff test/complete -> done]
Todo app verified end-to-end from a clean install; all automated and manual checks pass.

- Clean checkout flow: `rm -rf node_modules && npm install` succeeds with 0 vulnerabilities; `npm start` boots the server immediately.
- Automated suite: `npm test` (vitest) passes 6/6 tests across test/health.test.js and test/todos.test.js — covers create, complete, and list filtering.
- Manual API verification against a running server on all routes (mounted under `/api/todos`, not `/todos`):
  - Create with due date and without due date — both return 201 with expected shape.
  - Due-date validation: impossible calendar date (`2026-99-99`) rejected 400, non-string due date rejected 400, valid leap day (`2024-02-29`) accepted 201.
  - List all / list filter=open / list filter=done all return correct subsets.
  - PATCH mark done, undo, and edit title all work and update `updatedAt`.
  - DELETE returns 204 and the item is gone from subsequent list calls.
  - Server restart: killed and relaunched the process; prior data (minus the deleted item) was still present, confirming persistence.
  - GET / serves the UI page (200, contains 'Todo' content).
- No new dependencies were introduced; server process was stopped after verification.
